<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Animated Bamboo Figure](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2763)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Supple but strong bamboo strips woven into intricate patterns form the base of the animated bamboo figure. These materials are plentiful and easy to come by, though they require great care and patience to prepare, making them ideal guardians for isolated communities. These hollow and pliable handcrafts can stretch or compress, jumping and springing farther than most humanoids.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Construct](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4)): DC 16

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 11
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 2">[Animated Bamboo Figure](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2763)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Construct" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=35" />
<trait label="Mindless" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=108" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Tian Xia World Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=223) pg. 279

**Perception** +8; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12)

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +10, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +10

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +4

**Dex** +4

**Con** +3

**Int** -5

**Wis** +0

**Cha** -5
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 18 (16 when broken); construct armor

**Fort** +9 

**Ref** +10 

**Will** +6 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 30

**Hardness**
3
</row>

**Immunities**
bleed, death effects, disease, doomed, drained, fatigued, healing, mental, nonlethal attacks, paralyzed, poison, sickened, spirit, unconscious, vitality, void

**Construct Armor** Like normal objects, an bamboo figure has Hardness. This Hardness reduces any damage it takes by an amount equal to the Hardness. Once an animated kite is reduced to less than half its Hit Points, or immediately upon being damaged by a critical hit, its construct armor breaks and its Armor Class is reduced to 16.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 30 feet, climb 15 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
fist +10 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)),
**Damage** 1d8+4 bludgeoning plus [Knockdown](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=46)

**Spring Forward** <actions string="Two Actions" />  The animated bamboo figure jumps up to 30 feet and makes two fist Strikes against different targets. It can use Knockdown following this activity, attempting to Trip each creature struck.

</column>
